title: 32-bit Barrel Shifter
statement: Implement a 32-bit barrel shifter that performs logical left and logical right shifts based on a direction input. The shift amount is a 5-bit value from 0 to 31. The module should be combinational and preserve zeros in vacated bit positions.
module_signature: module barrel_shifter_32bit(input [31:0] a, input [4:0] shamt, input dir, output [31:0] y);
behavior: If dir is 0, shift a left by shamt bits logically.
If dir is 1, shift a right by shamt bits logically.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use registers or sequential shifting operations.
hint: Use nested conditional assignments for the shift amount.
